protocol.prehistory: fixed S100, strict CUDA live GNN, no annealing/injection; freeze all subsequent refreshes after probe except one REFRESH intervention
protocol.effect: raw HOLD-minus-REFRESH tour length; percent=100*(HOLD-REFRESH)/HOLD; not optimality gap
protocol.tie_policy: exact if raw=0, near if 0<abs(raw)<=1e-6, otherwise improvement/harm
protocol.signal: stagnation at probe with absolute 1e-6 significant incumbent improvement
protocol.recent_improvement: (incumbent(t-50)-incumbent(t))/50 raw length per iteration; also percent per iteration
protocol.prior_metrics: mean abs, RMS, max abs, relative L2 divided by max(norm(old),1e-12), row-centered RMS; float64 analysis of immutable float32 actual priors
protocol.predictive_analysis: Three separate descriptive linear least-squares models per horizon: age indicator; age+categorical phase; age+phase+log1p(stagnation). Leave one independent instance out; training-only scaling; target raw benefit, MSE in squared raw length; rank and condition diagnostics retained; no hypothesis-test p values. Recent rate and prior magnitude association descriptive only.

coverage_gate.technical: all 72 decisions exact and no corrupted/missing observations
coverage_gate.strata: at least 4/6 age-phase groups have stagnation range >=25, >=3 distinct durations, and >=3 instances with within-instance across-seed variation
coverage_gate.outcomes: at least 18/72 non-ties at primary horizon and >=2 non-ties in at least 4/6 strata
coverage_gate.predictive: model3 LOIO MSE <=0.9*model2 overall, improves in >=3/4 held-out-instance folds, stagnation coefficient same sign in >=3/4 folds
coverage_gate.interpretation: These are predeclared exploratory screening rules, not significance thresholds. If any coverage prerequisite fails: INCONCLUSIVE, stop. No threshold tuning.

protocol.expansion: Only if all gates pass and projected remaining cost fits a separate 1200s cap: four more exploration instances dataset_seed=20261202, then four independent confirmation instances seed=20261203; freeze feature specification and coefficients before confirmation. No expansion otherwise.
protocol.limitations: Prior age is not randomized and is tied to exact iteration offset. Phase/age controls remove coarse group means, not all exact-iteration or search-history confounding. Seeds, probe times and nested horizons are correlated.

timing: strict CUDA live inference with diagnostic hashes; full prefix replay and suffix diagnostic overhead included; not ordinary runtime
